note: Single source of truth for the Movie DNA vector. Order is the vector order and must never change. Adding a dimension means appending it here, mirroring it in services/api/app/traits.py, and re-running the trait pipeline.

dimensions.description: How much the film turns on inner states, unreliable perception and mental conflict.
Presence and weight of reveals that reframe what came before.
How much the film withholds information and invites the viewer to solve it.
Moral ambiguity and interiority of the main characters.
How heavily the film leans on emotional impact.
Explicitness and frequency of violence. Used for filtering as well as matching.
How distinctive and deliberate the cinematography and design are.
How unresolved the ending is left.
